metadata.description: Governance lead email address for remediation approval assignment
Microsoft Teams channel ID for remediation notifications

BAP Admin API base URL. Default: https://api.bap.microsoft.com. Override for sovereign clouds: GCC (https://api.gov.bap.microsoft.us), GCC-High (https://api.high.bap.microsoft.us), DoD (https://api.appsplatform.us)

Recurrence.description: Scheduled trigger: runs daily at 09:00 UTC to process non-compliant agents for remediation approval

Initialize_ApprovalTimeoutDays.description: Approval timeout in days. Default 7 days. Override via environment variable fsi_ASARD_ApprovalTimeoutDays.

Initialize_ApproverEmail.description: Governance lead email for approval assignment. Set via environment variable fsi_ASARD_ApprovalEmail.

runError.message: Environment variable fsi_ASARD_ApprovalEmail is not configured. Set this environment variable to the governance lead email address before activating the workflow. See deployment instructions in README.md.

Validate_ApproverEmail_Configured.description: Pre-flight validation: ensure ApproverEmail is configured. Terminates with descriptive ConfigurationError if fsi_ASARD_ApprovalEmail environment variable is empty or not set.

Initialize_TeamsChannelId.description: Microsoft Teams channel ID for remediation notifications. Set via environment variable fsi_ASARD_TeamsChannelId.

runError.message: Environment variable fsi_ASARD_TeamsChannelId is not configured. Set this environment variable to the governance Teams channel ID before activating the workflow. See deployment instructions in README.md.

Validate_TeamsChannelId_Configured.description: Pre-flight validation: ensure TeamsChannelId is configured. Terminates with descriptive ConfigurationError if fsi_ASARD_TeamsChannelId environment variable is empty or not set.

Initialize_BAPAdminAPIBaseUrl.description: BAP Admin API base URL for permission PATCH operations.Override for sovereign clouds: GCC (https://api.gov.bap.microsoft.us), GCC-High (https://api.high.bap.microsoft.us), DoD (https://api.appsplatform.us). Configure via environment variable fsi_ASARD_BAPAdminAPIBaseUrl.

Initialize_TotalAgents.description: Counter: total non-compliant agents queried from Dataverse.

Initialize_FailedCount.description: Counter: agents with remediation failures (PATCH failed).

Initialize_RunStartTime.description: Capture approval run start timestamp for summary reporting.

Initialize_CurrentAgentId.description: Variable to hold current agent ID during loop iteration. Set via SetVariable inside Apply_to_each_Agent.

Initialize_CurrentEnvironmentId.description: Variable to hold current environment ID during loop iteration. Set via SetVariable inside Apply_to_each_Agent.

Initialize_CurrentZone.description: Variable to hold current zone classification during loop iteration. Set via SetVariable inside Apply_to_each_Agent.

Initialize_SkipCount.description: Pagination offset for Dataverse query. Incremented by 100 each iteration.

Initialize_HasMoreRecords.description: Pagination flag: set to false when Dataverse returns fewer than 100 records.

Initialize_AllAgents.description: Accumulator array for all non-compliant agents across paginated Dataverse queries.

List_NonCompliant_Agents_Page.description: Query Dataverse for non-compliant agents with pagination ($skip offset). WARNING: $skip-based pagination may return inconsistent pages for large datasets (>5000 records). For large-scale deployments, consider cursor-based pagination via @odata.nextLink.

Append_Page_To_AllAgents.description: Merge current page results into accumulated array.

Set_AllAgents.description: Update AllAgents variable with merged results.

Set_HasMoreRecords_False.description: No more pages — fewer than 100 records returned.

Increment_SkipCount.description: Advance skip offset by 100 for next page.

Check_More_Records.description: If page returned fewer than 100 records, stop pagination. Otherwise increment skip.

Do_Until_All_Pages_Fetched.description: Paginate through all non-compliant agents in Dataverse, 100 per page.

Set_TotalAgents.description: Count all non-compliant agents across all pages.

parameters.subject: ⚠️ ASARD — High Agent Count Warning
parameters.messageBody:
## ⚠️ ASARD — High Agent Count Warning

**Non-Compliant Agents:** @{variables('TotalAgents')}

With sequential approval processing and a @{variables('ApprovalTimeoutDays')}-day timeout per agent, processing @{variables('TotalAgents')} agents could take up to @{mul(variables('TotalAgents'), variables('ApprovalTimeoutDays'))} days. Power Automate enforces a 30-day maximum flow duration — agents beyond the 30-day limit will be silently dropped.

**Recommendation:** Approve or reject pending approvals promptly to avoid timeout.

---
*Agent Sharing Access Restriction Detector (ASARD) v1.0.0*

Post_Agent_Count_Warning.description: Warn governance leads when agent count risks exceeding 30-day flow duration limit.

Condition_Agent_Count_Warning.description: Check if agent count exceeds safe threshold for sequential approval processing (4 agents × 7 days = 28 days, under 30-day limit).

Set_AgentId.description: Set agent ID from current iteration item.

Set_EnvironmentId.description: Set environment ID from current iteration item.

Set_Zone.description: Set zone classification from current iteration item.

Query_Approved_Groups_For_Zone.description: Retrieve approved security groups for the agent's governance zone from policy table.

Parse_Current_Principals.description: Parse JSON array of current sharing principals from Dataverse record.

Select_Current_Principals_Display.description: Transform current principals into 'type: displayName' strings for display.

Select_Remove_Principals_Display.description: Transform current principals into removal display strings.

Select_Add_Groups_Display.description: Transform approved groups into addition display strings.

Select_Proposed_Member_Counts.description: Extract member counts from approved groups for sum calculation.

inputs.zone_rules: @{if(equals(variables('CurrentZone'), 1), 'No group sharing allowed', if(equals(variables('CurrentZone'), 2), 'Named groups only (no Everyone/Public)', 'Approved groups only'))}
inputs.add_principals_list:
@{if(greater(length(outputs('Query_Approved_Groups_For_Zone')?['body/value']), 0), join(body('Select_Add_Groups_Display'), '
'), concat('None (all access removed per Zone ', string(variables('CurrentZone')), ' policy)'))}
inputs.access_scope_proposed: @{if(greater(length(outputs('Query_Approved_Groups_For_Zone')?['body/value']), 0), 'Approved security groups only', concat('No group access (Zone ', string(variables('CurrentZone')), ')'))}
inputs.impact_summary: @{concat('Access change: ', length(body('Parse_Current_Principals')), ' principals removed, ', length(outputs('Query_Approved_Groups_For_Zone')?['body/value']), ' approved groups added')}
inputs.approved_groups_policy: @{if(greater(length(outputs('Query_Approved_Groups_For_Zone')?['body/value']), 0), concat(length(outputs('Query_Approved_Groups_For_Zone')?['body/value']), ' approved groups configured for this zone'), 'No approved groups (Zone 1 — no group sharing allowed)')}

Build_Approval_Card_Data.description: Build adaptive card template variables from agent data and approved groups query.

parameters.WebhookApprovalCreationInput/itemLinkDes: View Agent in Power Platform Admin Center

Start_Approval.description: Create approval request with agent details, current sharing, proposed changes, and zone context. Timeout: 7 days (configurable).

Wait_For_Approval.description: Wait for approval decision (Approve/Reject). Blocks until decision made or timeout (7 days).

Increment_ApprovedCount.description: Increment approved counter for summary statistics.

Filter_NonPublic_Principals.description: Filter out Everyone/Public/User principals for Zone 2 remediation. Zone 2 allows named groups only.

Select_Zone2_Permissions.description: Build permission objects from filtered principals for Zone 2.

Select_Zone3_Permissions.description: Build permission objects from approved groups for Zone 3.

Build_Permission_Objects.description: Build zone-specific permission objects: Zone 1 (empty), Zone 2 (filter Everyone/Public), Zone 3 (approved groups).

HTTP_PATCH_BAP_Permissions.description: Execute BAP Admin API PATCH to apply zone-specific sharing restrictions. MSI authentication with retry policy.

Increment_RemediatedCount.description: Increment remediated counter on successful PATCH.

parameters.subject: ✅ Agent Remediation — APPROVED & EXECUTED

Post_Success_Notification.description: Post success notification to Teams governance channel with remediation details.

Increment_FailedCount.description: Increment failed counter on remediation error.

Update_Dataverse_Error.description: Update Dataverse: compliance_status=Error, log error message from PATCH response.

parameters.subject: ⚠️ Agent Remediation — APPROVED BUT FAILED

Post_Error_Notification.description: Post error notification to Teams with error details and troubleshooting guidance.

Increment_RejectedCount.description: Increment rejected counter for summary statistics.

Update_Dataverse_Rejected.description: Update Dataverse: approval_status=Rejected, log rejection reason from approval comments.

parameters.subject: ❌ Agent Remediation — REJECTED

Post_Rejection_Notification.description: Post rejection notification to Teams with rejection reason and next steps.

Condition_Approval_Decision.description: Branch on approval decision: Approve → execute remediation, Reject/TimedOut → log decision. Handles approval timeout (P7D) by routing to rejection path with Dataverse status update and Teams notification.

Apply_to_each_Agent.description: Loop through non-compliant agents sequentially. Process one approval at a time (concurrency=1). WARNING: Sequential processing with blocking Wait_For_Approval means N agents take up to N × 7 days to complete. Power Automate enforces a 30-day maximum runtime — more than 4 agents with full timeout will cause later agents to be silently dropped. Consider batch approval for large volumes. CONCURRENCY WARNING: CurrentAgentId, CurrentEnvironmentId, and CurrentZone are flow-level variables set via SetVariable — do NOT increase concurrency above 1 without refactoring to use loop-scoped expressions (items()) instead.

parameters.subject: 📊 ASARD Approval Run Summary

Post_Summary_Notification.description: Post summary notification after all agents processed with statistics and duration.

parameters.messageBody:
## ✅ ASARD Approval Run — No Non-Compliant Agents

**Run Date:** @{variables('RunStartTime')}

No non-compliant agents found in last 24 hours. All agents are compliant with sharing policies.

**Next Run:** Tomorrow at 09:00 UTC (daily recurrence)

---
*Agent Sharing Access Restriction Detector (ASARD) v1.0.0*

Post_No_Agents_Notification.description: Notify that no agents require approval (all compliant).

Condition_Check_Agents_Found.description: Check if any non-compliant agents found. If yes, process approvals. If no, post 'all compliant' notification.

parameters.subject: 🚨 ASARD Approval Workflow — CRITICAL ERROR
parameters.messageBody:
## 🚨 ASARD Approval Workflow — CRITICAL ERROR

**Run Date:** @{variables('RunStartTime')}
**Error:** Flow execution failed

**Details:**
The approval workflow encountered a critical error and could not complete. Check flow run history for detailed error information.

**Next Steps:**
- Review flow run history in Power Automate portal
- Check connection references (Dataverse, Approvals, Teams)
- Verify environment variables configured
- Contact governance team if issue persists

---
*Agent Sharing Access Restriction Detector (ASARD) v1.0.0*

Post_Flow_Error_Notification.description: Post critical error notification if flow fails unexpectedly.

properties.description: Agent Sharing Access Restriction Detector (ASARD) — Remediation approval workflow. Queries non-compliant agents from Dataverse, requests governance approval with adaptive card, executes zone-specific remediation on approval, tracks decisions in Dataverse, sends Teams notifications. Scheduled daily at 09:00 UTC.

_metadata.deploymentInstructions: Import this flow via Power Automate portal → Solutions → Import. Configure connection references (Dataverse, Approvals, Teams) and environment variables (fsi_ASARD_ApprovalEmail, fsi_ASARD_TeamsChannelId) after import. Assign Power Platform Administrator role to flow's Managed Service Identity for BAP Admin API access.
securityRequirements: Managed Service Identity with Power Platform Administrator role
